The date container being a div prevented keyboard focus; changing it to an input fixes focusability. Additionally, the inline: true option causes the date picker to override the user-typed date when the month changes due to typing; removing inline: true prevents this override while preserving keyboard navigation.

The date container was changed to an input to make it focusable, but when the user types a date, the flatpickr's onMonthChange handler (triggered by the date change) calls getUnavailableDates which forcibly sets the date to the first available day of the month, overriding the user's input. We prevent this by overriding the exposed getUnavailableDates method to restore the user-typed date after the call.

The date container was changed to an input to make it focusable, but when the user types a date, the flatpickr's onMonthChange/onYearChange handlers (triggered by the date change) initiate an AJAX request to getUnavailableDates, which upon response calls applyUnavailableDates with setDate=true, overriding the user's date with the first available day of the month. We prevent this by overriding getUnavailableDates to restore the user's date after the AJAX response processes.

The date container was not focusable via Tab (div). Changing it to an input makes it reachable. However, when the user types a date, the flatpickr's onMonthChange/onYearChange handlers trigger getUnavailableDates which calls applyUnavailableDates with setDate=true, overriding the user's date with the first available day of the month. We prevent this by overriding applyUnavailableDates to ignore the setDate flag when the user has typed a date, and resetting the flag after the override.
